exposure: women who experienced their first pregnancy more than 2 years after menarche (late group)
time from obstetric fistula formation to presentation
women who experienced their first pregnancy up to 2 years after menarche (early group)
cohort: 270 patients with obstetric fistula caused by a long obstructed labor
finding: There was no significant difference in the frequency of obstetric fistula during the first pregnancy between women who experienced their first pregnancy within 2 years of menarche and those who experienced it later.
